violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Particle board shelving units in lower level not properly sealed.

Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. Convection oven in kitchen not placed fully under hood system. Discoloration of wall and ceiling evident.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. General cleaning needed in lower level bakery area. Flour dust on most items.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Boxes of single service items being stored on floor in lower level storage room.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors around line equipment have grease/food debris build up and need cleaning. Water damaged ceiling/walls in lower level walk in cooler have mold developing. Need proper cleaning and sanitizing.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Walls/ceiling in lower level walk in cooler have water damage.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Wiping cloth used with raw animal food was not separated from use with non-raw animal wiping cloths. Bucket sanitizer concentrations too low. Test on a regular basis to ensure proper sanitizing concentrations are maintained.

Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. Convection oven not located under hood system. Walls and ceiling discolored around oven.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Reach in coolers need cleaning. Line cooking equipment needs cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Counters under grills on cook line have an accumulation of grease and food debris and need cleaning. Reach in single door cooler on cook line has food debris and spills. Needs cleaning. Ladder racks and sheet trays in walk in cooler have food residue and are in need of cleaning. Lower level of restaurant has an accumulation of bakery dust and is in need of cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors in walk in units, upper and lower levels, have an accumulation of debris and food. Need cleaning. Walls in lower level walk in cooler need cleaning from a recent drain line leak. Floor in kitchen needs cleaning under cooking equipment, shelving units, and coolers.
